power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: He taumaha te pupuri i tō tinana āhuahira  ka tere ake te 75% o te wā o te matekai.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_night_vi: Ka werohia e ō kanohi te pōuri.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Whakawhiti: haere i roto i ngā poraka mārō me te rere i te wā e rere ana. 25% iti iho te mate kai. Kei te aukati tonu a Obsidian me te toka.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Ko ngā hoariri e tata ana ki a rātou i roto i ngā poraka e toru, e pāngia ana e te ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Te Whakamutua o te Whakaaro ki te Maama o te Ra
Kei te mura tonu te māramatanga o te rā, engari he haurua te kaha.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Te āhua ā-rangi (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Whakawhiti: haere i roto i ngā poraka katoa, haunga te toka taketake me te rere i te wā o te wā. He iti rawa te mate kai. Kāore he mea e ārai i a koe.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Kua pūmau tō āhua ātaahua  he 25% noa iho te tere o te mate kai i te wā noa iho.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Te matatini
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: He putea wheua ora ake  tere, māmā, me te whakamate ki te kopere. Ko te anga ngoikore, e karohia ana e te rā, ā, ka taea anake e ia te kai i ngā kai kino rawa.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Ko te hunga ora
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: He undead koe. Ka whara i a koe ngā rongoā whakaora, ka whara i a koe ngā rongoā kino, ā, ka whara anō i a koe ngā whakaari a Smite.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Ka taea e ia te ora i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 whiu bonus ki ngā patu pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Te maramarama o te wheua
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: E 20% te tere o ōu waewae i ōu wheua kōhao.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: He ngawari te taumaha
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.descripti: Whakatere 30% teitei ake i te tikanga.
Ko ō wheua ngoikore ka whakaiti i tō hauora mōrahi ki te 7 ngā ngākau.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Ka tahuna koe i te ra tika ki te kore e mau he potae.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Te Kai Kāore i te Bone
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Ka taea anake e koe te kai i te paraoa wheua, te kikokiko pirau, me ngā kanohi ngārara.
He kai te paraoa wheua ki a koe.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Te waikura
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: He rauropi maroke e tika ana kia noho mātao kia ora ai, e peke ana i runga i ngā hinganga, e wehe atu ana i te mate i te wā e makuku ana, ā, ka kaha ake i te wheako.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Te makuku
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: E whai koe i te pae haumākū e heke haere ana i te wā. He tere ake te heke i roto i te koraha me te ahi. E tū ana i roto i te wai, i te ua rānei ki te rehydrate. I runga ake i te 75%: Regen 1. I raro iho i te 10%: -4 patu. I te 0%: ka whara koe.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Te wehenga
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: I a koe e mate ana i runga ake i te 75% te haumākū, ka wehea koe hei utu  teleporting 50 poraka atu me ngā ngākau e rua. HP ka whakahoutia ki te tikanga i roto i ngā meneti e rua.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Te Whanaketanga Gelatinous
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 HP mōrahi mō ia 10 taumata wheako. Whakahokia ki te mate.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: Kāore koe e pāngia e te hinganga  ka peke koe.

power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_hp.name: Te Whakapaipai o te Ora
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_conduit_po: Te manawa wai tonu, te kitenga pō, me te Haste  i runga i te whenua me raro i te wai.
